title: Example post: my desk setup (draft)
excerpt: This is a draft that shows how affiliate products are embedded in a post. Set Published to on and edit it, or delete it.
body:
## Why this setup

Write your post in **Markdown**. Put an affiliate product card anywhere with a line like this:

[[product:example-product]]

Products you list in the *Products* field also appear in a box at the end of the post.
